raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The [DeepGEMM release job](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39866337913/job/120130535490) fails during dependency preflight because upstream removed `tilelang_ops.ref_mhc` after moving the mHC PyTorch reference into its test file.

## Modifications

Remove the obsolete `ref_mhc` import and `has_baseline()` assertion, together with their unused `sys` import and `sys.path` setup. The remaining dependency checks and GPU release test invocation are unchanged.

## Accuracy Tests

- `pre-commit run --hook-stage pre-commit --files .github/workflows/release-whl-deepgemm.yml`
- YAML parsing, `bash -n` on the dependency-install step, and compilation of its embedded Python passed.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- Actionlint has no new diagnostics relative to `main`: the existing five custom runner-label findings and one SC2086 remain.
- GPU release workflow not run locally; this change only removes the obsolete preflight check.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable; no runtime or kernel changes.
